name: PM Vishwakarma Scheme
description: PM Vishwakarma is a Central Sector Scheme designed to support traditional artisans and craftspeople who work with their hands and tools across 18 traditional family trades.
benefits: Provides official PM Vishwakarma Certificate and ID Card, 5-7 days basic training and 15 days advanced training with ₹500/day stipend, a ₹15,000 digital voucher grant for purchasing modern toolkits, and collateral-free enterprise credit up to ₹1,00,000 (1st tranche) and ₹2,00,000 (2nd tranche) at a concessional interest rate of 5%.
eligibility: Indian artisans and craftspeople engaged in one of the 18 specified traditional trades on self-employment basis. Minimum age 18 years. Limited to one member per family. Must not have availed similar government loans in the last 5 years.
documents: Aadhaar card linked to mobile number, bank account details, ration card or family composition declaration, and trade verification declaration.
application_process: Register through Common Service Centers (CSCs) on pmvishwakarma.gov.in using Aadhaar biometric authentication. Applications pass through 3-tier verification (Gram Panchayat/ULB, District Implementation Committee, and Screening Committee).

eligibility_criteria.target_group: Traditional artisans and craftspeople across 18 specified trades
